business_problem: Itaú needed to make financial guidance simpler and more personalized for millions of customers while also scaling document-heavy internal workflows, all under the governance, observability, and economic controls required in a highly regulated banking environment.
solution_summary: Itaú built a dual-layer generative AI stack around customer experiences and governed internal model access. ia.i is the bank's conversational surface, available by text or voice, that brings checking-account, credit, card, insurance, and other service interactions into one interface and connects customers to specialist human support when needed. Behind that surface, Customer DNA maintains financial context about needs, habits, and life stages for roughly 70 million customers, while OpenAI models help enrich the representation and answer requests with the right balance of latency, cost, and reasoning depth. The bank exposes those models through IARA, a governance and orchestration platform that applies policy controls, observability, and token-efficiency guardrails, and the same platform also powers document reading, analysis, and interpretation for the legal department's 90M+ document repository.

solution_components.name: ia.i
solution_components.role: Provides the text- and voice-based conversational layer for customer banking interactions and handoff to human specialists.

solution_components.name: Customer DNA
solution_components.role: Maintains the financial context used to personalize interactions around customer needs, habits, and life stages.

solution_components.name: OpenAI models
solution_components.role: Handle customer-facing and internal tasks across low-latency flows and higher-reasoning workflows.

solution_components.name: IARA
solution_components.role: Controls governed access to multiple models with observability, policy enforcement, and cost management across bank teams.

data_flow: Customers submit text or voice requests through ia.i, which uses Customer DNA context plus banking-service information to route work to the appropriate OpenAI model and return answers, guidance, or transaction help before escalating to human specialists when needed. In parallel, legal documents flow through IARA so governed model access can read, analyze, and interpret items from the department's repository.
business_outcome: Itaú put generative AI in front of approximately 300,000 customers in ia.i's first phase, created a governed platform for scaling AI across customer and employee workflows, and improved legal-process efficiency by 20% to 80% while handling more than 2 million tasks per month against a 90M+ document corpus.

architecture_clues: ia.i supports multimodal interactions across text, voice, image, and clicks in one experience.
IARA centralizes model access with governance, observability, and token-efficiency controls.
Customer DNA provides context about needs, habits, and life stages for approximately 70 million customers.
The legal workflow runs on more than 90 million documents and over 2 million tasks per month.
Responsible AI controls and bias reduction are treated as product requirements in a regulated banking environment.
